subject: MAP kickoff with new champion + accelerated eval timeline
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Introducing Tom + MAP reset and accelerated eval proposal

Hi Sara / Tom —

Following up on our paused MAP after the org changes on your side: welcome Tom — glad to have you as the new champion. I know there was momentum earlier; our goal here is to re-establish a tight, measurable evaluation window so your team can make a decision before end of quarter.

Attached: FinSight_MAP_v1.xlsx (initial reset), plus a short SOC2 evidence summary we referenced for procurement. Quick summary of what I propose:
- Scope: model eval for customer-facing summarization (3 prompt families, 5 datasets) + latency/cost runbook.
- Timeline: compressed 3-week evaluation (kickoff call, prioritized test cases, weekly review + final signoff).
- Roles: Tom — champion (day-to-day), Sara — executive sponsor, Monica — CS technical lead (integration), Michael — sales lead.
- Deliverables: updated MAP, access to private sandbox, core test prompts and eval metrics, final readiness checklist.

Can we meet for 30 minutes Thursday May 18 at 10am PT to align scope and owners? If that works, Monica will share the access checklist and test data.

Thanks — excited to get back on track.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0114

Thanks, Michael — and thanks for the welcome.

Tom is stepping in as Head of ML Ops and will own the evaluation. Our leadership is keen on a faster outcome but we need to ensure procurement sees the SOC2 artifacts. I think a 3–4 week window is reasonable given internal reviews; curious whether Redwood can compress test execution (e.g., run parallel ingestion + scoring) so we hit the lower bound.

Thursday 5/18 10am PT works for us. I’ll invite our procurement lead if we hit contract discussion territory.

—Sara

Subject: Post-call: agreed compressed MAP, owners, next steps

Hi all — thanks for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and agreed actions (see updated MAP attached):

Decisions
- Timeline: 3.5 week evaluation window (kickoff 5/18, mid-point checkpoint 5/26, final decision 6/03). This compresses the original plan but keeps all critical gates.
- Scope: Prioritize summarization use-case + 2 lightweight classification tests for bias/regression detection.
- Access: Redwood to enable sandbox credentials and an S3 endpoint for test data; FinSight to provide a redacted production sample (<= 2GB).

Owners
- Tom Brooks (FinSight): champion, day-to-day on test execution and acceptance criteria.
- Sara Kim (FinSight): exec sponsor and procurement liaison.
- Monica Patel (Redwood): CS lead — onboarding, test harness, and weekly demo.
- Michael Grant (Redwood): sales owner — commercial/contract coordination.
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood): sales leader — discount/credits approval if needed.

Action Items (owners and due dates)
- Monica: share sandbox runbook + access instructions by EOD 5/18 (attachment: FinSight_MAP_v2.xlsx).
- FinSight (Tom): provide redacted sample and acceptance criteria by 5/21.
- Michael: share draft mutual NDA/LOE for legal review by 5/20 (HubSpot deal updated).
- Vivek: confirm promotional credit threshold for compressed eval by 5/20.

Notes:
- Procurement asked for the SOC2 PDF — attached SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf.
- HubSpot link to deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Please reply in-thread to confirm owners or raise any blockers. If no objections, Monica will provision sandbox credentials tomorrow.

Thanks —
Michael
